parts.note_add: The undescribed row after the set bolts on 0900A-1 (S-005 Body-Index p.25) reads RETAINER, LOCK CYLINDER, B001-62-495 (the OCR reads the prefix as B001, not 8001), fitted from FB331 501578-; the same figure lists the buzzer (key reminder) switch BA14-66-156 and the ignition switch BA24-66-155A (from FB331 642150-) as separate parts. Atkins Rotary lists the complete lock set at US$600, no longer available; used ignition lock cylinder and switch sets with key sell for about US$140 (Autopartone, sold out 2026-09-27).

Ilco's classic cross-reference gives two blanks for the 1981-82 RX-7 by key code series: X26 / MZ9 for codes 2500-2999 and X27 / MZ10 for codes 3000-3499 (the code is stamped on the lock or the original key; which series this car is, check). Mazdatrix sells a rotor-head blank for 1970-82 Mazdas in two profiles, type A and type B (relief groove on the bottom for type B), US$21 each, matched to the original key.

Held to the column jacket by two shear-head set bolts; the 1985 manual's procedure (S-002 sec.10A p.10A-14/15) removes the wheel, column covers and combination switch, splits the old bolts with a chisel and tightens the new ones until the heads snap off. The '83 bolt H043-66-154 is sold by Atkins Rotary for 81-95 RX-7s (US$9 each, two per car); the catalogue lists 8218-66-143 for '81-'82 (S-005 Body-Index p.25). No new lock listed; used sets only.

Described by owners as an unpainted one-piece natural-rubber spoiler held by seven threaded studs moulded into the rubber (10 mm nuts), five metal slots taking plugs into the body, and self-tapping screws at the leading tips (rx7club thread, S-005 cited there; check on the car). No new or reproduction one-piece spoiler found; Atkins Rotary's 79-85 rear wing (US$350) is no longer available, used only.

The 1985 manual's instrument-panel structural view (S-002 sec.14 p.14-2) numbers 32 pieces from the horn cap to the panel itself: column covers, combination switch, switch panels, glove pocket lid and compartment, ash tray, centre panel, radio, clock, garnishes, meter hood and cluster come off before the panel bolts (4); the 1985 dash differs in detail from the '82. The only CAD is a partial dash scan whose generation is not stated.

New pads are not sold; the options are a glued-on cap (Mazdatrix MZTX-24-707B black US$157.30 or burgundy US$236.25; Accuform ACCU-400 high-temperature ABS dash cap for 1978-83, US$183.59) or restoration of the original pad by Just Dashes, Van Nuys CA (818-780-9005).
A printable glove box catch scanned from a 1985 FB exists (cad row fb-glove-box-catch-printables-themagicd); whether the '82 striker 8871-64-101 matches it, check.
No new or reproduction lid found; Atkins Rotary and Mazdatrix list no glove box parts for 79-85, used only (salvage listings).

Used only: Autopart3 lists a grey 81-83 radio and climate-control bezel at US$287 (sold out 2026-09-27). An rx7club member has had the FB radio surround, column bezels and switch surrounds 3D-scanned for reprinting but has not released the files.
Discontinued by Mazda (Mazdatrix); used 81-83 dash ash trays sell for US$75-125 and the holder bracket US$58 (Autopart3, 2026-09-27).
Mazdatrix lists the 81-83 ash tray inner as 64-6300-FA01-00 (FA01-64-630-00), discontinued.

Mazdatrix lists FA01-60-220A as the 81-83 UPPER column cover and FA01-60-230 as the LOWER, both discontinued by Mazda, and the 1985 manual calls the pair upper and lower (S-002 sec.14 p.14-2): whether these halves split upper/lower rather than right/left, check on the car.
Mazdatrix lists FA01-60-230 as the 81-83 LOWER column cover (FA01-60-220A the upper), discontinued by Mazda; the right/left naming here, check on the car.
